Noah Kim: Heads-up: ran int4 canary for q3b-staging with a new 'stitch-suffix' augmentation in the ingest pipeline. Canary shows a concentrated mismatch on stitched multi-example prompts, different from prior concat issues.

Noah Kim: Quick run snippet:
```
run_id: q3b-int4-175210
examples: 1120
mismatch_rate: 0.039
cluster: stitched-multi-example, trailing-suffix tokens
```

Jules Martin: can you confirm this is the new stitch-suffix (v0.9) not the older synth-join? wondering if the trimming heuristics changed token indices.

Noah Kim: yes, stitch-suffix v0.9 (it appends + trims delimiter tokens). Also noticed a handful of tokenization edgecases where a unicode ellipsis collapsed into three periods post-tokenize.

Hannah Lee: paste 2 sanitized failing examples? Also run a fast de-dup check against golden; stitching can accidentally re-create golden items.

Noah Kim: sanitized examples:
- "Q: summarize || example A || example B" -> fp16 preserves ordering, int4 reorders bullets
- "Write steps: A; B; C || appended small example" -> int4 truncates last step
Ran a fingerprint de-dup: 6 overlaps with golden (likely regen id collision).

ops-bot: [qbench] summary: run=q3b-int4-175210 baseline=q3b-fp16-175000 delta_mismatch=+3.9% top_signals=[ordering, truncation, tokenization] link=https://qbench.local/runs/q3b-int4-175210

Jules Martin: proposed triage plan:
1) isolate stitch-suffix cohort and rerun canary with `--disable-stitch-suffix` to check augmentation isolation,
2) run int4 with kernelset `legacy-2026-01` and `--kvcache-trace` on 8 failing ids,
3) create a micro-golden backfill of 300 stitched-edgecases with dedupe and regen-id mapping.

Hannah Lee: I'll do (3) and ensure the micro-golden dedupe uses token-fingerprint+regen mapping, aiming to exclude regen collisions. ETA ~5h. I'll also add sample-stamps.

Noah Kim: I'll run (1) now and mute stitch-suffix from baseline for the test. Posting new qbench link shortly.

Jules Martin: I'll run (2), collect KV dumps, and diff first-256 tokens. If kernel fallback removes the delta, runtime needs a guard for trimmed prefixes.

Hannah Lee: opening ticket INF-1759: "q3b-int4: stitch-suffix longtail reordering & truncation". Tagging runtime+curation.

Noah Kim: thanks all. adding outputs and micro-golden s3 link to the ticket once ready. :thumbsup:
